name: Google Cloud
tagline: Cloud APIs, gcloud CLI, IAM, BigQuery, GKE, and AI infrastructure.
shortDescription: Google Cloud provides APIs, gcloud CLI, IAM, service accounts, BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE, and Vertex AI.
agentSummary: Agents can use gcloud and APIs for cloud resource management when constrained by projects, IAM, and dry-run plans.
bestFor: Cloud Run, BigQuery, GKE, storage, analytics, and AI platform operations.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: IAM, billing, production data, and infrastructure changes need human approval. Model behavior, costs, rate limits, data retention, and safety policies can change by model and account tier; use evals, spend caps, and data controls for sensitive workloads. MCP servers inherit the connected account's scopes and may send prompts or data to third-party services; configure read-only or narrow scopes when available. CLI access is powerful but can run destructive local or production commands; prefer dry runs, preview environments, and non-production credentials.
pricingSummary: Public per-service pricing and calculator, but cross-service cost can be complex.
authModel: Service accounts, OAuth, workload identity, IAM roles, and ADC.
accountCreation: Self-serve account/project creation with billing setup.
browserSupport: Console is important for billing, IAM, logs, and audits.
